title: azalea micrantha
intro: Azalea micrantha, commonly known as the Dwarf Azalea or Rock Azalea, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Azalea micrantha include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
